edits.old: SERVER-127943 documents a historical failure when a multikey wildcard PDIB resumes at bulk-load iteration zero: the resumed bulk builder restores _isMultiKey and _indexMultikeyPaths but omits _hasMultiKeyMetadataKeys, bypassing metadata-key deduplication and emitting duplicate ci operations that can crash a secondary with WT_DUPLICATE_KEY. [redacted] independently describes the fix as restoring the wildcard metadata flag on resume. (medium confidence)
edits.new: SERVER-127943 documents a bug where resuming an index build does not set BulkBuilderImpl::_hasMultiKeyMetadataKeys, so for a wildcard index the bulk builder may incorrectly try to insert a multikey metadata key twice. SERVER-129824 describes this as the wildcard multikey metadata key form of the duplicate container-insert (ci) family, where a duplicated ci op makes an applier fatally reject it with WT_DUPLICATE_KEY (fassert 34437), and says the fix restored _hasMultiKeyMetadataKeys on resume. Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-127943 ; https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-129824

evidence.quote: Resuming an index build does not set BulkBuilderImpl::_hasMultiKeyMetadataKeys when resuming, meaning that for a wildcard index it may incorrectly try to insert a multikey metadata key twice.
It fixed only the wildcard multikey metadata key form of this duplicate-ci family (by restoring _hasMultiKeyMetadataKeys on resume).
An applier that already holds those keys fatally rejects the duplicate with WT_DUPLICATE_KEY (-31801) -> fassert 34437.

evidence.quote: BF-43992 still occurs because the duplicated keys here are ordinary data keys: a different leak of the same _addKeyForCommit latch
The duplicated keys decode to ordinary integer-field index data keys (KeyString ctype 0x2C, kNumericPositive2ByteInt)

The latch assumes already-present keys form a contiguous sorted prefix of the drained keys. True for a fresh build; unsound on a resume whose container holds a non-contiguous subset of the keys being drained.
